{"basis":"measured","fact_type":"finding","name":"The dev_reflow2 family holds five facts twice and one fact too high; a similarity sweep at 0.4 finds a duplicate one time in eight, and 44 of its 52 pairs are real relations recorded only as text","statement":"Measured 2026-10-09, build order item 7, over the dev_reflow2 hub's family: reflow2 (main's export), the hub, flo2, flo2-cad, flo2-ifc, flo2-calc and integrated-flo, read from flo2.io's engine with flo2's ops/flo2-design-copy read step. 2,224 live requirements, decisions and capabilities. One search across designs is still not built (cap:search-design-reaches-the-designs-a-hub-tracks, planned); the manual check did not need it.

A SIMILARITY SWEEP (TF-IDF cosine on name and text, every cross-design pair at 0.4 or above): 52 pairs. Judged by hand:
- 6 (12%) the same fact held twice, 5 distinct facts;
- 25 one feature split correctly between its owners, or a whole and its piece;
- 13 the same standard restated per project (latest SDK, plugin spec, monthly dependency check), none linked to the hub's standards requirement;
- 8 unrelated.
All 25 split pairs and 13 standards pairs name each other only in prose; none is a typed link.

THE FIVE FACTS HELD TWICE:
- jot: flo2 dec:idea-jot-it-down-now-work-it-through-later OPEN; reflow2 req:a-jot-captures-an-idea-in-one-breath-and-sorts-it-later accepted.
- cheat sheet: flo2 dec:idea-a-new-person-learns-what-they-can-do-after-genesis OPEN; reflow2 dec:idea-a-person-learns-what-to-do-next-once-they-have-a-design settled.
- cross-seat channel: reflow2 dec:idea-reflow2-has-multi-seat-state-and-no-multi-seat-channel and flo2 dec:open-cross-seat-channel, both open, from one 2026-08-15 report.
- CAD route: flo2 dec:idea-fork-openscad-and-make-it-better-for-jewelry-making OPEN; flo2-cad dec:route-to-the-engine settled.
- ifcmcp SDK and plugin: flo2 req:ifcmcp-runs-on-the-latest-python-sdk-and-is-plugin-ready-through-upstream; flo2-ifc req:ifcmcp-uses-the-latest-mcp-python-sdk and req:ifcmcp-meets-the-agent-plugins-spec. The flo2 one is also the one fact held too high: it is wholly flo2-ifc's.
Three of the five are an idea left open in one design after another design answered it. Two arose when a new member design was started from an idea in flo2 and the original was not closed: the moment item 5's move now covers.

THE PARENT READ (all 39 intent records of integrated-flo and 4 of the hub, read in full): nothing held only in the parent that a member lacks. Two roll-ups have drifted: integrated-flo cap:design-a-piece-then-build-each-part-with-its-helper and cap:read-photos-of-a-real-object-into-a-pieces-named-parts are planned, while the flo2 capability each names by id (cap:a-served-skill-designs-a-physical-piece-before-building-it) is realized.

A LIMIT OF THE SWEEP: integrated-flo cap:hold-a-piece-whose-parts-cross-disciplines and flo2 dec:idea-one-design-holds-a-piece-whose-parts-cross-disciplines share a name and scored 0.18. That pair is legitimate: the integrated requirement says the how is open in flo2's idea.

The five duplicates and two drifts are left in place until reflow2's next release reaches flo2.io (Anthony, 2026-10-09), so they can be fixed with typed links and the move rather than with prose.","subject_id":"dec:idea-the-family-is-checked-for-facts-held-twice-or-held-above-the-lowest-design-that-owns-them","valid_from":"2026-10-09"}
